title: Chapter 53 Building A Village
content:
Chapter 53 Building A Village

Guliji gritted her teeth and said nothing. She looked a little angry, but she didn't take it too seriously.

After all, as long as she was alive, there was always a chance.

After escorting Guliji and others back to their shelter, Wang Shuo left the golden armored warriors to guard them, and added the protection of the arrow tower and energy tower.

Wang Shuo believed that basically no one could break through his shelter at this stage.

Then he took the three brothers of the Gong family to continue capturing players.

This small area at the foot of Watang Mountain was quickly swept by Wang Shuo twice, until there were no other players, Wang Shuo took the captured players back to the shelter.

At noon, Wang Shuo ordered Xiaona to prepare food, and he and Gong Zheng and others cleaned up the supplies seized today in the courtyard.

You don't know until you see it, you will be shocked when you see it.

[Wood +24531, Stone +18690, Iron Ore +12400, Rice +3500, Meat +8000]

There are also some weapons, 23 sets of armor, and 8500 gold coins.

Although Wang Shuo seized the players' backpacks, he also had system backpacks, which Wang Shuo could not view, so they must have some things on them.

But the most important thing now is to synthesize the 22 seized shelter hearts into a bronze village building order, and then build a village.

Coming to the "core of the territory" hut, Wang Shuo directly took out 10 shelter hearts and then silently said "synthesize".

[Bronze Village Building Order +1]

Put the bronze village building order into the light shield, it automatically flew in, and then merged with Wang Shuo's shelter heart.

[Congratulations on building your 50th village. ]

[Please name your village. ]

Wang Shuo thought for a while: "My village is at the foot of Watang Mountain, so let's call it Wana Village!"

There is no system announcement, and there is no reward.

It seems that only those who first built the village will get rewards.

Wang Shuo was not disappointed.

At this time, Wang Shuo's territory had undergone tremendous changes.

His courtyard was renamed the village administrative center. Although the layout did not change, the system prompted that there were many new buildings that could be built.

And a new page was added to his attribute panel.

[Territory attributes]

[Territory: Wana Village (Level 1 Village)]

[Lord: Wang Shuo]

[Area: 2 kilometers in radius]

[Population: 5]

...

Wang Shuo hurriedly discussed with Chang Gui.

As an old player, he must be allowed to play his light and heat.

"Agui, what else can you remember about the dispute over the village building order?"

"Lord, I suddenly remembered some fragmented memories today. Please let me sort out my thoughts."

"Okay, okay! Think about it slowly."

At this time, Xiaona also prepared the meal, and Wang Shuo called his three subordinates to eat together.

Looking at the three people in front of him, Wang Shuo felt a little regretful.

The main thing is that they lack the ability to think, and they can only respond simply when they are spoken.

This made Wang Shuo speechless.

When encountering any problems, there is no one else to discuss except to find the amnesiac Agui.

However, the tool man has the advantages of a tool man, and he can only comfort himself in this way.

Wang Shuo ate quietly. At present, every step he took was to cross the river by feeling the stones.

If he took a wrong step, he would be doomed, and it was really like walking on thin ice.

"Lord, I remembered an important process. It won't be long before a large number of wild beasts will appear in the wild. Their initial growth rate is faster than that of players. As long as they devour their own kind or players, they can upgrade. Therefore, it won't be long before the wild will be blocked by wild beasts."

"This is very unfriendly to lord players. Players who give up becoming lords can go directly to the system town for shelter, while lord players must stick to the wild and defend their territory."

"So in the early stage, population is very important. This is why I suggested to the lord to gather players at the beginning."

"At that time, I just made a subconscious suggestion, and now I think of the reason."

Wang Shuo raised his eyebrows, swallowed the chicken leg in his mouth, wiped his mouth, and said: "Do you mean that we will be surrounded by wild beasts later?"

This is not good news. I am isolated here. If I fail to hold on, it will be over.

"So, we must gather more players in the first few days and make them the subjects."

Wang Shuo thought for a long time. It seems that the battle for the village order is not only about the heart of the shelter, but also the players themselves!

After eating, Wang Shuo decided to have a good talk with them.

In the courtyard, Wang Shuo gathered all the captives together, a total of 19 people.

Being able to survive to participate in the battle for the village order, basically everyone has learned the life profession.

However, only Guliji has learned the combat profession.

Their levels are generally between 3 and 5, and it is already very good to have this level.

It means that they have participated in the battle. Although some people seem vulnerable and are easily captured by Wang Shuo, it can't be blamed on them. Who made Wang Shuo too strong!

"Everyone recognizes the current situation?" Wang Shuo scanned each person in turn with a sharp look.

The golden armored warrior stood beside Wang Shuo, and the three brothers Gong Zheng surrounded everyone.

In order to shock everyone, Wang Shuo directly took out 10 units of stone and piled them together.

With a thought, the energy tower was activated, and an energy attack was directly hit on the pile of stones.

Suddenly, the pile of stones broke into pieces, and the broken stones splashed on the players, and some players even lost blood.

The attack of the energy tower had a huge deterrent effect, and some players were already trembling!

"Then I'll get straight to the point. Since the battle for the village order began, we have become refugees, and now you have become my captives."

"Your life and death are only in my mind, but we all come from the same planet. I can't bear to slaughter my compatriots, but the situation is pressing and fighting is inevitable."

"Everyone knows that we are now in an extremely dangerous survival game. If you are not careful, you will die."

"So, I now hope that everyone will hand over all your supplies and join my territory. I can promise that if you don't do anything to harm the territory, I will give each of you a shelter heart after the battle for the village order is over."

"At that time, you can choose again, whether to truly join my territory or naturalize in the system town, I will respect everyone's choice."

"I warn everyone not to have a fluke mentality. If you do anything unwise, the stone pestle just now will be your end." Wang Shuo suddenly raised his voice and said in a serious tone.

Silence for a long time.

At this time, a thin player said timidly: "How can we trust you?"

"Well said, I don't dare to completely trust you!"

"I have a contract scroll here, which is approved by the system. If the two sides violate the agreement, they will be directly punished by the system."

Everyone has lived for 21 days, so naturally they believe in the authority of the system.

However, at this time, some players looked a little complicated.
